## Observable problem

Describe the receipt, verification, packaging, or documentation defect with a minimal safe fixture.

## Evidence

- [ ] Regression test
- [ ] Five-minute demo
- [ ] Deterministic eval
- [ ] Clean install
- [ ] Release validator
- [ ] No secret, external action, overwrite bypass, or expanded proof claim

## Receipt boundary

Confirm the change does not imply correctness, security, identity, authorship, authorization, sandboxing, certification, signature, or attestation.
